title: 第5章 收到回信第6章 我想修仙
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
众人循声看去，只见王芬的眼前凭空浮现出一块淡蓝色的透明光屏。
上面清晰显示着四个大字，下方还有一行小字与跳动的数字：
请确认收货
倒计时：00:19
“这、这是什么？”王芬吓得后退一步，脸色发白。
李局立刻上前：“怎么了？”
“我眼前突然出现屏幕，让我确认收货……”王芬声音发颤。
时间紧迫，李局当机立断，压低声音：不要确认收货！把我们要问的话写下来，放进黑盒子里，看看能不能直接传回给李婉！
副手立刻会意，快步准备纸笔。
“写隐晦一点，用拼音，别暴露太多信息。”李局补充道，防止消息被第三方截获，给李婉带来危险。
二十秒倒计时飞速流逝，王芬始终没有点击确认。
同一时间。
修仙界，流林宗，后山灵草场。
正在放羊的李婉脑海里，突然响起熟悉的系统提示音：
【收件人未确认收货，快递已退回，请宿主及时签收。】
李婉心中一紧，立刻在心里点下签收。
下一秒，一叠折好的a4纸和一支黑色水笔“啪嗒”一声，轻轻落在她脚边的草丛里。
李婉心脏狂跳，警惕地环顾四周。
确认没有其他杂役路过，她一屁股蹲在半人高的灵草丛中，飞快展开纸张。
两张a4纸，一张写满字，一张空白。

上面是一行行工整的拼音，字迹略显潦草，却透着急切：
李婉，你好。
国家已接收到你的快递，你的爸妈也一切安好。
我们想确认你的安全，如果可以，请在下次寄回快递时，详细说明你的遭遇、修仙界环境、快递系统功能，以及催生符的相关信息。
国家不会放弃任何一个公民，我们会尽一切力量，接你回家。
短短几行字，李婉看了一遍又一遍，眼泪瞬间夺眶而出。
爸妈没事！官方收到了她的快递！他们还在雪山等着她的消息！
甚至猜到她没有纸笔，还贴心地连下次回信的工具都一起寄了过来。
滚烫的眼泪滴在纸上，李婉用力抹了把脸，又哭又笑。
她快速将信纸折好，和怀里藏着的两张催生符一起，分别塞进两只鞋的鞋垫底下。
特殊时期，顾不上干净不干净，只要藏得隐蔽不被发现就好。
那支笔，则被她小心别在内衣领口，贴身藏好。
地星，玉龙雪山临时基地。
当众人眼睁睁看着黑盒子带着那张写满疑问的信纸，在一阵微弱的光芒中凭空消失时，所有人的脸上都露出了震撼与激动。
技术人员同步汇报：“黑盒消失瞬间，磁场紊乱、能量峰值爆表，但无法捕捉任何空间轨迹！”
物证被紧急送往首都最高级别的国家实验室。
尤其是那三张泛黄的催生符，成为整个研究的核心。
content_en:
Everyone followed the sound and saw a light blue transparent light screen appearing out of thin air in front of Wang Fen's eyes.
Four large characters are clearly displayed on it, and there is a line of small characters and jumping numbers below:
Please confirm receipt
Countdown: 00:19
"What, what is this?" Wang Fen took a step back in fright, her face turning pale.
Director Li immediately stepped forward: "What's wrong?"
"A screen suddenly appeared in front of me, asking me to confirm receipt..." Wang Fen's voice trembled.
Time was running out, Director Li made a quick decision and lowered his voice: Do not confirm receipt! Write down what we want to ask, put it in the black box, and see if it can be sent directly back to Li Wan!
The deputy immediately understood and quickly prepared paper and pen.
"Write in a subtle way, use pinyin, and don't reveal too much information." Bureau Li added to prevent the message from being intercepted by a third party and putting Li Wan in danger.
The twenty-second countdown passed quickly, and Wang Fen never clicked to confirm.
at the same time.
In the world of cultivating immortals, Liulin Sect, Lingcaochang in the back mountain.
Li Wan, who was herding sheep, suddenly heard a familiar system prompt:
[The recipient has not confirmed receipt of the goods and the express delivery has been returned. Please sign for it in time. 】
Li Wan's heart tightened and she immediately signed in her heart.
The next second, a folded A4 paper and a black pen fell gently into the grass at her feet with a "snap" sound.
Li Wan's heart was beating wildly and she looked around cautiously.
After confirming that no other handyman was passing by, she squatted down in the tall grass and quickly unfolded the paper.
Two pieces of A4 paper, one full and one blank.
Above are lines of neat pinyin, the handwriting is slightly sloppy, but it is full of urgency:
Li Wan, hello.
The country has received your express delivery, and your parents are fine.
We want to confirm your safety. If possible, please explain in detail your experience, the environment of the world of immortality, the functions of the express delivery system, and the relevant information about the birth talisman when you return the express next time.
The country will not give up on any citizen, and we will do everything we can to take you home.
Li Wan read just a few lines over and over again, and tears burst into her eyes instantly.
Mom and dad are okay! Officially received her express delivery! They are still waiting for news about her in the snowy mountains!
He even guessed that she didn't have pen and paper, and thoughtfully sent her the tools to reply next time.
Hot tears dripped on the paper, and Li Wan wiped her face hard, crying and laughing at the same time.
She quickly folded the letter and stuffed it under the insoles of her shoes together with the two fertility charms hidden in her arms.
In special times, it doesn’t matter whether it is clean or not, as long as it is hidden and not discovered.
The pen was carefully pinned to the collar of her underwear and hidden close to her body.
Earth Star, Jade Dragon Snow Mountain temporary base.
When everyone watched the black box and the letter filled with questions disappear into thin air in a burst of faint light, everyone's faces showed shock and excitement.
The technicians reported simultaneously: "The moment the black box disappeared, the magnetic field was chaotic and the energy peak exploded, but no space trajectory could be captured!"
The physical evidence was rushed to the highest-level national laboratory in the capital.
In particular, the three yellowed birth talismans became the core of the entire research.
